trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing to do for this one directly. Work the roadmap stages in order and lean on this tracker's counters for the long grinds. PowerPyx rates the full set 4/10 difficulty at roughly 200 hours, and a single playthrough is enough.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission. It unlocks on its own as you play the prologue — no choices, medals or collectibles are tied to it. Like every story trophy it is hidden on PSN until earned, which is why this tracker spoiler-protects it.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1; the trophy unlocks at the chapter card. Before you close this chapter out, do the meditation at home — one of the 18 spots for Positive Mental Attitude exists only during Chapter 1, and it is the one genuinely missable point in the whole list (see that trophy's guide).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. From this chapter both Jason and Lucia are playable, which opens up the partner trophies elsewhere in the list. Keep a manual save at the chapter start: the game has no mission replay, so a chapter save is your only way back to anything you rushed past.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story progress only — nothing optional is gated behind it. This is a good chapter to build the checklist habits: scan new vehicles and study animals through the binoculars as you travel, because both feed the 100% checklist behind A Long Road.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. Make a manual save before you start the final stretch — the last mission follows directly, and with no mission replay a pre-finale save is cheap insurance for any one-time feat you still want to attempt.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission to close the story — this is the gold story trophy. Free roam continues after the credits, so almost everything else on this list can still be cleaned up afterwards. PowerPyx puts the whole five-chapter story at roughly 60–80 hours.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a scripted story beat, so simply play it when it appears on the map — it cannot be skipped, failed permanently or locked out by an earlier choice.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist, the story's big score. The trophy is for completing the heist, not for a particular approach, crew choice or take, so play it as it comes in the campaign — no setup for it is missable.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. A straight campaign mission: follow the markers, play the set pieces as they come, and the trophy unlocks at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. Campaign progress only — nothing optional feeds it, and it stays available until you choose to play it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish VCIA Takedown, the airport mission. While you are at VCIA for this mission you also have the natural window for Catch Me If You Can — an unscheduled departure from the same airport — so keep an eye out for a chance to leave by air outside the script before the mission wraps up.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory. A scripted story operation: play through its beats and the trophy unlocks at completion. Nothing in it is optional or one-time beyond the mission itself.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist (Progress > Stats, viewable after the story). The checklist is far kinder than it looks: PowerPyx reports it needs roughly 60% of true completion — 70 of the 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied — although robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests must be done in full. Both guide sites rate this the hardest trophy in the set, mostly for its length.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts at the stunt spots scattered over Leonida. They are repeatable free-roam content, so this silver is a grind rather than a skill wall: clear stunt locations as you cross the map for other trophies and let the counter here pace you. Stunt progress also feeds the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the game's 9 activity types once — races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, bowling and the rest each count the first time you play them. This is the cheapest trophy on the list if you sample activities as they unlock instead of saving them all for the cleanup.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Shooting ranges are one of the categories the 100% checklist wants done in full, so this silver does double duty. Learn each weapon class's target pattern on a first pass, then replay for gold — challenges can be retried as often as you like.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list & PSN targets

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. There are 42 drone races in total, but the trophy only asks for a win at each location, not every race. Drone races are another category the 100% checklist requires in full, so clearing locations as you find them pays twice.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list & PSN targets

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race types count as long as they are distinct events, so work through the race series dotted around the map and tick each win off here. If one race keeps beating you, come back in a faster owned vehicle instead of repeating it in a stock one.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so this also ticks a box for Master of None. Find Cal's challenge at the fishing spots, learn the reeling timing on a practice fish first, then take him on — the challenge can be retried if he wins.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Cabinets sit in arcades and bars around Vice City; pick the shortest game on offer, finish a full run of it, and the trophy is yours. It also counts as the arcade entry for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger strand: work through every mission Andy gives you until his final one. Stranger strands appear as question-mark markers on the map, and this strand is one of the eight that Strangers & Freaks counts. PowerPyx's roadmap clears all strands in the cleanup step, after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger strand, ending with his final mission. Take each of Kenton's jobs as the strand marker moves around Leonida; the trophy unlocks when the strand closes, and the strand counts toward the eight needed for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger strand through to his final mission. Billy's chain is one of the eight strands Strangers & Freaks needs, so there is no reason to leave it half-done once you start it.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. A strand only counts when the stranger's whole chain is finished, not at the first meeting. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone's strands all count toward the eight; use the counter here to track finished strands rather than started ones.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list & PSN targets

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger strand, ending with his final mission. Randy's chain counts toward Strangers & Freaks; play each leg as it appears and the trophy unlocks when the strand resolves.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger strand through to his final mission. Like the other named strands it feeds Strangers & Freaks, so finish the chain once you pick it up rather than leaving it between stages.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots, spread across 10 locations in Leonida, using both Jason and Lucia. This is the list's one genuinely missable trophy: the first spot, the meditation at home, exists only during Chapter 1 and is gone for good once the chapter ends — and there is no mission replay to go back for it. Meditate at home before you finish Chapter 1, then sweep the remaining 17 spots in free roam at your leisure.
trophies.missNote: The Chapter 1 home meditation spot is permanently unavailable after Chapter 1 ends. Meditate at home before completing Paradise Lost.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret sends you after. Bret's quests are one of the categories the 100% checklist requires in full, so take his hunting jobs as they appear rather than saving them. Study the animal through the binoculars first (animal studies feed the checklist too), then make the kill cleanly.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden pickups all over Leonida, and a set means every card of that themed run — not any 3 loose cards. Sweep region by region alongside the meditation spots and WAiNK locations so you are never crossing the state for a single pickup.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list & PSN targets

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations across Leonida. WAiNK points are marked spots all over the state, so like the card sets this is a map sweep best done by region. The counter here is the honest way to pace a 100-stop route — clear a district an evening rather than saving all 100 for the end.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list & PSN targets

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 challenges in the game and the 100% checklist only insists on 70, so for this trophy you can skip the 30 that suit your play style least. The counter here plus the in-game challenge list tells you exactly where you stand.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list & PSN targets

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner riding with you, reach a 4-star wanted level and then lose it completely. Commit crimes together until four stars show, then break line of sight and wait out the search somewhere quiet, or swap vehicles to cool the trail. Easiest once both Jason and Lucia are playable from Chapter 2.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without the wanted level dropping off in between. Plan a tight triangle of stores, keep your partner with you, and move fast — the chain breaks if the heat fully cools between robberies. A quick car waiting outside the third shop makes the getaway simple.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — get close to, or into, 100 different models so they register in your vehicle log. The 100% checklist separately wants 200 of the 277 vehicles scanned, so keep going after this trophy if you are chasing A Long Road. New districts are the fastest source of models you have not seen.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list & PSN targets

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside a single Combat Focus activation. Save it for a crowded fight — a gang operation or a busy mission shootout — trigger Focus when at least five enemies are out in the open, and drop them before the meter runs out. If it goes wrong, reload and retry; nothing about this one is one-time.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — leave the airport by air outside any scheduled flight or script. The natural window is the VCIA Takedown story visit: get into an aircraft on the field and take off when the mission is not asking you to. If you miss that window, the airport stays open in free roam, so you can try again from the airfield side.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The description points at the Rhino tank: get into a confrontation with one and come out the other side — draw serious military attention until a Rhino responds, then escape it or disable it. Launch-era guides still list this trophy's exact trigger as not yet pinned down, so treat any precise recipe as unconfirmed; a long high-wanted rampage near military ground is the reported route.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no shots fired, no alarm raised, cases emptied and out the door before anyone reacts. A careful night approach with your partner waiting in the car is the safe pattern; if you are spotted, let the attempt go and try another store.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Vault robberies are also a category the 100% checklist wants done in full, so these five pay into A Long Road as well. Case each bank first and plan the escape before you start: the getaway, not the robbery, is where attempts usually fail.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list & PSN targets

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The trucks run routes in free roam: block one with a heavy vehicle, breach the rear doors, take the cash and break away before the response arrives. A blocker vehicle for the stop and a fast one for the getaway makes it routine.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — the map fog lifts area by area as you enter them. Most areas open up naturally across the story and the collection sweeps; the stragglers are usually the islands and the far corners of the map. Compare your map against the area counter here when you reach the cleanup.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list & PSN targets

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs operations somewhere in Leonida; hit one per gang rather than farming whichever is nearest. The counter here tracks gangs, not robberies — nine different owners, one operation each.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list & PSN targets

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the Ocean Beach strip in Vice City, order a cocktail at a beachfront bar and take in the view. Launch guides still list this trophy's exact trigger as unconfirmed, so if it does not pop at the first bar, work along the rooftop and beachfront spots on the same strip.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom: steal a car inside the showroom and drive it straight out through the glass. Pick a showroom stocking a car you want anyway, and the trophy should pop as the glass breaks. Guides list the precise showroom as unconfirmed at launch, so any glass-fronted dealership is worth trying.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a game at the bowling alley owned by Kolt & Associates — the trophy's name is the game's own nod to a famous cousin from a previous city. A full game at the alley is the safe bet, and it also ticks the bowling entry for Master of None.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The description is one of the cryptic ones: it concerns Jason and Lucia's partnership, and launch guides are still pinning the exact trigger down. Play the partner content — hangouts and joint activities with both characters — and expect it around the story's partnership beats. Treat any more specific recipe as unconfirmed until the guide sites settle it.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: PSN tracks this one to 500: perform 500 actions that feed your Criminal Profile, the running record of your choices and crimes. It accrues naturally across a full playthrough; if you are short at cleanup time, ordinary free-roam crime moves the counter. Note that your Criminal Profile standing is permanent — with no mission replay, choices tied to it cannot be rewound.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list & PSN targets

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: the reported shape of this trophy is failing at something specific and then succeeding on the retry. PowerPyx lists it among the not-yet-known at launch, so keep the manual-save habit — when a one-off attempt fails anywhere, reload or retry it rather than moving on, and the trophy should surface on the second success.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the game's UFO-flavoured encounter. This one is cryptic by design and unconfirmed in launch guides: Leonida's swamps and night skies are where players report odd lights and things that do not belong. If you see something strange, stop and watch it play out; the witnessing is the trophy.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock a pedestrian down with a melee drive-by: swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle — a bike makes the swing easiest — and connect with someone on foot. Low speed and a crowded sidewalk are your friends; it takes timing, not damage. The bowling joke in the name is literal: ten-pin the pedestrian.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies; instead of spending them raw, pass them through your laundering contacts until the cumulative laundered total crosses a quarter of a million. The counter here tracks dollars, so log the big scores as you hand them over.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list & PSN targets

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in total. Clothes, weapons, vehicles and services all feed the same pot. This usually lands on its own during a full run — garages and vehicle upgrades are the fastest way to close a late gap.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list & PSN targets

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought from property listings around Leonida, and they give your growing vehicle collection somewhere to live. Save the pricier ones until after the heist money lands, and tick each purchase off here as you sign.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list & PSN targets

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. When you find a vehicle worth keeping, register it in the app instead of just driving off. Ten registrations is a short evening's driving if you swap cars whenever you reach a new district.
trophies.name: On the Spot

sources.name: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list & PSN targets
